configuration.description: Mixed inference, embedding, evaluation, and training loads with arrivals spread through the horizon.
configuration.horizon_rationale: Fixed 60-minute primary evaluation window; the staggered arrivals and 18-minute maximum nominal duration leave substantial service margin, but the horizon is not a drain-to-empty guarantee.
configuration.name: Balanced baseline
configuration.seed_behavior: Workload profile and topology are fixed by suite version; arrival jitter and failure traces are deterministic for the supplied seed.

configuration.description: Large batches arrive together and again later, contending for a shared queue.
configuration.horizon_rationale: Fixed 75-minute primary evaluation window preserves three burst waves and a long post-arrival service window; it measures backlog recovery without extending selectively for any policy.
configuration.name: Burst arrivals
configuration.seed_behavior: Workload profile and topology are fixed by suite version; arrival jitter and failure traces are deterministic for the supplied seed.

configuration.description: Burst arrivals, mixed priorities, GPU-type requirements, power pressure, and node failures interact.
configuration.horizon_rationale: Fixed 90-minute compound-stress window spans the 80-minute maximum nominal deadline while keeping bursts, power limits, model constraints, and seeded failures active; it is not extended to force queue drain.
configuration.intended_stress: Compound constraints and policy trade-offs under shared exogenous failures.
configuration.name: Combined operational stress
configuration.seed_behavior: Workload profile and topology are fixed by suite version; arrival jitter and failure traces are deterministic for the supplied seed.

configuration.description: Memory-heavy jobs compete across nodes with sharply different memory per accelerator.
configuration.horizon_rationale: Fixed 65-minute primary window provides service time beyond the 58-minute maximum nominal deadline while retaining the intentionally skewed memory topology; impossible placements are terminally diagnosed.
configuration.name: GPU memory pressure
configuration.seed_behavior: Workload profile and topology are fixed by suite version; arrival jitter and failure traces are deterministic for the supplied seed.

configuration.description: Workloads require different accelerator classes across a mixed-capacity pool.
configuration.horizon_rationale: Fixed 65-minute primary window exceeds the staggered arrival and maximum nominal service interval; structurally incompatible GPU/memory requests remain visible as infeasible, not as horizon failures.
configuration.name: Heterogeneous GPU requirements
configuration.seed_behavior: Workload profile and topology are fixed by suite version; arrival jitter and failure traces are deterministic for the supplied seed.

configuration.description: A mixed feasible queue includes requests exceeding all node resource envelopes.
configuration.horizon_rationale: Fixed 45-minute primary window is designed to evaluate the feasible portion of the mixed queue; 12-GPU/512-GB requests exceed every node envelope and are reported as permanent infeasibilities.
configuration.intended_stress: Explicit detection of impossible GPU and memory requests without unsafe placement.
configuration.name: Infeasible workloads
configuration.seed_behavior: Workload profile and topology are fixed by suite version; arrival jitter and failure traces are deterministic for the supplied seed.

configuration.description: Latency-sensitive workloads share capacity with lower-priority batch work.
configuration.horizon_rationale: Fixed 70-minute primary evaluation window spans the staggered queue and 65-minute maximum nominal deadline; it evaluates deadline outcomes rather than promising that all jobs drain.
configuration.intended_stress: Priority ordering versus deadline and throughput trade-offs.
configuration.name: Mixed priorities and tight deadlines
configuration.seed_behavior: Workload profile and topology are fixed by suite version; arrival jitter and failure traces are deterministic for the supplied seed.
